subject.title: Field Report: 25 findings from 4 weeks of self-hosted production use (config crashes, CLI docs, Discord, cron)

question: Should maintainers keep this broad field report open as the routing umbrella, or split the remaining current-main slices into focused canonical issues and then close this umbrella?
rationale: The remaining work spans config recovery policy, message catch-up, cron ergonomics, web-search/tool policy, onboarding UX, resource policy, and update process behavior; source inspection cannot choose the desired tracking shape or product defaults.

options.title: Split Then Close Umbrella
options.body: Link fixed slices to current source, keep the open config and missed-inbound issues canonical, open only focused follow-ups for any remaining current-main behavior, then close this broad issue.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open until every slice is fixed or rejected, accepting weaker automation signal because it spans several owners and product decisions.

options.title: Close as Partially Superseded
options.body: Close now with links to the narrower open issues and ask reporters to file any slice that still reproduces on current main.

recommendation.title: Split Then Close Umbrella
recommendation.body: Link fixed slices to current source, keep the open config and missed-inbound issues canonical, open only focused follow-ups for any remaining current-main behavior, then close this broad issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent area work cover several central touched paths, making this the best available routing owner from history evidence.
